sources.rasterAvailability: The published raster URLs returned Login HTML; no raster is included or used.

scaleCalibration.method: Median meters per native display pixel derived from every published polygon with an exact room ID and listed square-foot area. At least 40 independent shapes; classroom area checks reported separately.

limitations: Only L1 room boundaries are available for the four schedule keys 127, 133, 139 and 140; upper-floor classroom geometry remains unavailable.
L1 outlines consist of the exact available space polygons, not a reconstructed external wall or complete slab. Three listed L1 service spaces have no polygons.
L2 contains only the single published public circulation polygon (C)253; its small outline represents this partial coverage, not the whole second floor.
Native image coordinate frames are retained. Alignment between floors has not been independently established. The model has no campus geo registration or true-north direction.
The local meter scale is calibrated against rounded official listed areas; this is not surveyed dimension or current CAD accuracy. Floor elevations and heights remain explicitly estimated.
The viewer is a legacy public FIS source. Raster requests returned Login HTML, so no plan revision date or raster wall details are claimed. The HTML DC.Date is not treated as a drawing revision.
MCC 250 is corroborated by the Department of Communication Democracy Lab page, but is absent from this public second-floor inventory. Its floor remains inferred from the room number.
